tos_hub_description: Please read the relevant terms before commissioning. Click a card below to view the full terms for each service.
tos_hub_art_desc: Terms for digital art commissions — illustrations, character art, and more.
tos_hub_fursuit_desc: Terms for physical fursuit commissions — heads, partials, and full suits.
tos_art_meta_desc: Meowcha's art commission terms of service — digital illustrations, character art, and more.
tos_fursuit_meta_desc: Meowcha's fursuit commission terms of service — heads, partials, and full suits.
tos_fursuit_consent_notice: By paying a down payment (DP) or filling out the commission form, you are considered to have read, understood, and agreed to all the following points.
tos_fursuit_s1_age_desc: Commissioners must be at least 18 years old. For minors, transactions MUST be handled by a parent or legal guardian.
tos_fursuit_s1_risk_desc: Meowcha is not responsible for physical injuries (falls, trips), accidents, or health issues (dehydration, overheating) arising from fursuit use. Use responsibly and have a handler/companion when performing.
tos_fursuit_s1_copyright_desc: Meowcha reserves the right to take and post WIP photos/videos and the finished fursuit on social media for portfolio and promotional purposes.
tos_fursuit_s2_payment_desc: Payment is made via Bank Transfer (Bank Jago or other as invoiced) and is inclusive of tax.
tos_fursuit_s2_dp_desc: A 50% DP is required to secure your slot and purchase materials. The DP is Non-Refundable if the order is unilaterally cancelled by the customer.
tos_fursuit_s2_final_desc: The remaining 50% must be paid after the fursuit is 100% complete and BEFORE the item is shipped.
tos_fursuit_s2_installment_desc: Meowcha does not accept installment payment plans without prior written agreement.
tos_fursuit_s2_ref_desc: Commissioners must provide clear 2D SFW reference art. AI-generated artwork is NOT accepted as a reference.
tos_fursuit_s2_color_desc: Meowcha will do their best to match fabric/fur colors to the 2D reference, however some tolerance in color difference between actual fabric and monitor display is expected.
tos_fursuit_s3_time_desc: Estimated completion is 4–6 months after all materials are gathered. There are no absolute deadlines or rush orders.
tos_fursuit_s3_wip_1: Shape revisions (headbase/foam) can ONLY be made during the foam base WIP stage.
tos_fursuit_s3_wip_2: Once the sewing/fur-cutting stage is approved by the commissioner, major design changes will incur additional charges for materials and labor.
tos_fursuit_s3_size_desc: The customer is fully responsible for the accuracy of measurements provided (head circumference, arm length, leg length, etc.). Sizing errors due to incorrect customer data are not Meowcha's responsibility.
tos_fursuit_s4_shipping_desc: Free shipping within Java Island. Shipping outside Java or internationally is fully covered by the buyer.
tos_fursuit_s4_damage_desc: Meowcha is not responsible for delays, damage, or loss caused by the courier/shipping service.
tos_fursuit_s4_warranty_1: Valid for 1 month from the date the item is received, covering technical maker defects such as loose stitching or adhesive failures.
tos_fursuit_s4_warranty_2: Does NOT cover: damage from rough use, improper care/washing, or self-modifications.
tos_fursuit_s4_warranty_3: Warranty shipping: shipping to the studio is covered by the buyer; return shipping to the buyer is covered by Meowcha (Java Island only).
tos_fursuit_s5_misconduct_desc: Meowcha reserves the right to unilaterally cancel a commission without a refund if the customer engages in rude, abusive, or threatening behavior.
tos_fursuit_s5_cancel_maker_desc: If Meowcha must cancel a project due to emergency or technical reasons, a full 100% refund will be issued if work has not yet begun, or a refund minus the cost of materials already used.
tos_fursuit_s5_ghost_desc: If the commissioner provides no response for 30 consecutive days, or fails to make the final payment within 30 days after the unit is complete, the order is considered Void. Rights to the fursuit will be transferred or resold by Meowcha, and previous payments are non-refundable.
tos_fursuit_s6_material_desc: High-quality synthetic fur (faux fur) with a headbase constructed from Upholstery Foam.
hero_description: Heyyowww! wellcome to the Cat Tree! I'm Meowcha, your favorite caffeinated green cat. I'm here for the vibes on the little corner of the internet.
bio_card_description: Yes, I'm green. Yes, my name has 'Meow' in it. But if you bring Matcha near me, we're going to have a problem! It's pronounced Mocha (MOKA), like the coffee. I'm just a domestic house cat who stayed in the forest a little too long and started matching the scenery.
tos_general_1: You must be of legal age and accept Meowcha's specific art style and skill level.
tos_general_2: Accepted exclusively through Bank or PayPal invoices in USD.
tos_general_3: Artworks focus on SFW, NSFW, and suggestive drawing.
tos_ordering_1: Clear visual references are mandatory for the ordering process.
tos_ordering_2: Invoices must be paid upfront and within 72 hours of receipt.
tos_ordering_3: There are 3 to 4 stages in my workflow: sketch, line art, color, and/or shading.
tos_ordering_4: You will receive one rough sketch for approval.
tos_ordering_5: You will get 2 free minor revisions during any point of the process.
tos_ordering_6: You may ask for major changes with extra cost (discuss with the artist first).
tos_ordering_7: You must reply to Work-In-Progress (WIP) updates within three days, or Meowcha will assume approval and continue to the next stage.
tos_delivery_1: High-resolution PNGs (300dpi) are sent via Proton Drive.
tos_delivery_2: You will receive watermarked versions (for web posting with credit) and an unwatermarked version (strictly for your private, personal collection—do not post).
tos_delivery_3: Custom resolutions and aspect ratios are available if requested.
tos_turnaround_1: Completion generally takes 3 to 8 weeks, depending on the queue size and real-life circumstances.
tos_turnaround_2: You may ask for faster delivery with 50% extra charge, and your commission will be bumped to the first queue.
tos_privacy_1_desc: Standard commissions that the artist can publicly showcase with or without credit to you.
tos_privacy_2_label: Private use/NDA for SFW (free) and for NSFW (+20%):
tos_privacy_2_desc: Ensures the artwork is kept completely off all public galleries and your identity remains hidden.
tos_copyright_artist_1: Meowcha retains the copyright to the created artwork itself, but makes no claim over your personal characters.
tos_copyright_artist_2: Meowcha may use the artwork for self-promotion and portfolio displays unless the private tier is purchased.
tos_copyright_artist_3: Meowcha will not use your commissioned piece for commercial profit.
tos_copyright_client_1: Strictly personal use, including reposting with "Art by Meowcha" credit, cropping for icons, and personal prints (e.g., posters, t-shirts).
tos_copyright_client_2: You cannot use the art for commercial purposes, claim you drew it yourself, or upload the unwatermarked/private files.
tos_copyright_client_3: Full commercial rights are not included by default and must be negotiated individually.
tos_blockchain_1: Under no circumstances can the commissioned artwork be used for Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs), Cryptocurrency, or Artificial Intelligence (AI) training and generation.
